author: mark
text:
state: retire branches.json; single-source-of-truth principle

Removes .agent/state/branches.json and src/prompt/branches.rs.
Git already records which branches exist — `git branch --list ex/*`
is the unmerged-branch query, and its length is the §8 health
metric. No mirror file, no consistency-protocol problem.

Adds 'Single source of truth' to PRINCIPLES.md: every piece of data
is recorded in at most one place; derive, don't mirror. Cross-
references from ARCH §2.3 and §8.

Unwinds bl-a764; bl-e7e1's exchange-branch flow unchanged.
